thread:
Ava Ruiz: Heads-up 10min sync: we're iterating the Pulse warmup cadence for the launch newsletter. Goal: maximize webinar signups w/ minimal sends. Plan doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/pulse-warmup-v1
Marta Chen: Proposal: 4 cohorts with progressive friction: 1) recent engagers (3-touch), 2) curious (2-touch + webinar invite), 3) silent (1-touch + blog link), 4) registrants (reminder-only).
Sanjay Patel: Nice. Need concrete segment rules and size estimates. Also ensure trial users are suppressed for 90d.
Ben Ortiz: I'll build a dynamic template supporting content swapping (demo CTA vs benchmark CTA) and timezone-aware send tags. UTM: utm_medium=email&utm_source=pulse&utm_campaign=pulse_warmup_v1
Leo Novak: Send windows: 10am local primary; for APAC do 9am local. Stagger batches by shard_key to avoid spikes.
Ava Ruiz: Subject lines A/B per cohort. Recent engagers use technical hook; silent uses curiosity-led copy. Keep preheader <90 chars.
Marta Chen: Cold cohort = single high-value link to benchmark blog with CTA "See results". Curious cohort gets invite + short how-to.
Sanjay Patel: Tracking: dashboard marketing.pulse.warmup_v1. KPI targets: open 21%, CTR 3.8%, webinar sign 5% overall. Set alerts for CTR drops >30% vs baseline.
OpsBot: Current marketing throttle: 2500 msgs/min per region, burst 5000 for 10m. See ops: https://ops.redwood.ai/batch-throttle
Ben Ortiz: Will run a 50-recipient internal smoke test once template is staged. ETA: Thu EOD.
Marta Chen: I'll finalize copy variants and pull one customer quote and one benchmark stat for the recent-engagers drip.
Leo Novak: Also add a send cap per account: max 1 email per 7 days to avoid over-mailing.
Ava Ruiz: Action items: Ben = template + smoke test; Marta = copy + assets; Sanjay = finalize segments & exports; Leo = shard schedule & caps; Ava = set looker alerts. Quick check Monday AM before go. Tag when tests complete. :thumbsup:
